answer: Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Reaching the inlet of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on succinct non-interactive computational proofs attesting to execution honesty. Written in a analytical prose structured with explicit logical operators and causality register, it stays short. The quill holds work receipts rather than names, so the umber of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
